Inhouse Read uses a mixed Supertonic 3 model package.

Original model: Supertone/supertonic-3
Revision: 3cadd1ee6394adea1bd021217a0e650ede09a323
License: BigScience Open RAIL-M (see supertonic3-OpenRAIL-M.txt).
Original model copyright: Supertone Inc.

Modified graph: onnx/vector_estimator.onnx only.
Source: askurios8/supertonic-3-int8
Revision: 95618f5d61cef4923c3b802a332fd603723718f7
Path: variants/mixed-fast/onnx/vector_estimator.onnx
SHA-256: 073575704bf0b6ca0714eb6509029f324b794d5bd6dbdb27dccbbc5939abc167
Modification described by its publisher: ONNX Runtime dynamic quantization,
QUInt8, per channel. No retraining. This is a community derivative, not an
official Supertone model release. It retains the original Open RAIL-M license.

Inhouse Read keeps the original FP32 duration predictor, text encoder and
vocoder, together with the original configuration, indexer and voice styles.
The separate MIT license applies to the inference recipe adapted from the
Supertone JavaScript SDK, not to the model weights.

Synthetic speech is generated by an AI model. Generic language support is not
a claim of a particular regional accent or dialect.
